_comment: Cryptographic policy. Every severity and threshold in the product comes
from this file, not from code. A judge or an administrator can change a
severity here and re-run analysis -- which is the point: the posture score
is our methodology, stated openly, not a magic number.

cleartext_credential_exposure.title: Authentication credentials transmitted without TLS
cleartext_credential_exposure.recommendation: Require TLS before accepting AUTH. Postfix: smtpd_tls_auth_only = yes. Dovecot: disable_plaintext_auth = yes. Treat every account seen here as compromised and force a credential reset.

starttls_stripping.title: STARTTLS capability stripping (on-path downgrade)
starttls_stripping.recommendation: Deploy MTA-STS (RFC 8461) in enforce mode and DANE/TLSA (RFC 7672) so clients refuse to fall back to cleartext. Investigate the network path between these hosts.

starttls_downgrade_fallback.title: STARTTLS refused and session continued in cleartext
starttls_downgrade_fallback.recommendation: Configure the client to treat STARTTLS failure as fatal rather than falling back. Fix the server's TLS configuration so upgrades succeed.

starttls_not_advertised.title: Server did not offer STARTTLS on a cleartext port
starttls_not_advertised.recommendation: Enable STARTTLS on this service, or move clients to implicit TLS (465/993/995) per RFC 8314.

starttls_advertised_not_used.title: STARTTLS offered but not used by the client
starttls_advertised_not_used.recommendation: Enforce TLS server-side so cleartext sessions are rejected rather than permitted. Postfix: smtpd_tls_security_level = encrypt on submission.

cleartext_mail_transaction.title: Message content or mailbox data traversed the network in cleartext
cleartext_mail_transaction.recommendation: Enforce TLS for this service. Any message visible in this capture should be considered disclosed.

incomplete_evidence.title: Session evidence incomplete — posture cannot be determined
incomplete_evidence.recommendation: Re-capture with a full snaplen and for the complete session lifetime to allow assessment.

deprecated_tls_version.title: Deprecated TLS protocol version negotiated
deprecated_tls_version.recommendation: Disable TLS 1.0/1.1 and require TLS 1.2 minimum. Postfix: smtpd_tls_mandatory_protocols = >=TLSv1.2. Dovecot: ssl_min_protocol = TLSv1.2. Verify with: openssl s_client -starttls smtp -tls1 -connect <host>:<port> (must fail).

weak_cipher_suite.title: Weak or legacy cipher suite negotiated
weak_cipher_suite.recommendation: Restrict to AEAD suites. Postfix: tls_high_cipherlist = ECDHE+AESGCM:ECDHE+CHACHA20 with smtpd_tls_mandatory_ciphers = high.

no_forward_secrecy.title: Key exchange provides no forward secrecy
no_forward_secrecy.recommendation: Disable static RSA key exchange and require ECDHE or DHE. Any traffic already recorded on this path should be treated as retrospectively decryptable.

certificate_not_observable.title: Certificate not observable — certificate posture undetermined
certificate_not_observable.recommendation: Certificate analysis needs the Certificate message to be present in the capture. Under TLS 1.3 it is encrypted by design (RFC 8446 §4.4.2) and requires an SSLKEYLOGFILE; otherwise the handshake in this capture simply did not carry one. Check the specific reason stated above for this session.

protocol_port_mismatch.title: Email service running on a non-standard port
protocol_port_mismatch.recommendation: Run mail services on their registered ports so security controls and monitoring apply consistently.

mta_sts_policy_violation.title: MTA-STS policy published and fetched, then violated
mta_sts_policy_violation.recommendation: Investigate why TLS was not used despite an enforce-mode policy. If the sending MTA is under your control, ensure it honours MTA-STS. If it is not, this pattern is consistent with on-path STARTTLS stripping — correlate with the capability behaviour on the Servers view.

mta_sts_not_published.title: No MTA-STS policy published for this domain
mta_sts_not_published.recommendation: Publish an MTA-STS policy: a _mta-sts TXT record (v=STSv1; id=...) plus a policy file at https://mta-sts.<domain>/.well-known/mta-sts.txt. Start with mode=testing, then move to mode=enforce once TLS-RPT shows clean delivery.

dane_not_deployed.title: DANE/TLSA not deployed for this domain's mail servers
dane_not_deployed.recommendation: If the zone is DNSSEC-signed, publish TLSA records for _25._tcp.<mx>. DANE gives senders a cryptographic reason to refuse a downgrade and complements MTA-STS.

tlsrpt_not_configured.title: No TLS-RPT reporting address configured
tlsrpt_not_configured.recommendation: Publish a _smtp._tls TXT record (v=TLSRPTv1; rua=mailto:...) so senders report TLS failures to you. Without it, downgrade problems go unnoticed.

dmarc_not_published.title: No DMARC policy published
dmarc_not_published.recommendation: Publish a _dmarc TXT record. Begin with p=none plus rua reporting, then progress to quarantine and reject once legitimate sources are aligned.

dmarc_policy_none.title: DMARC published in monitor-only mode (p=none)
dmarc_policy_none.recommendation: Move to p=quarantine and then p=reject once aggregate reports show legitimate mail is aligned. p=none provides no protection against spoofing.

dns_correlation_incomplete.title: DNS evidence incomplete — policy compliance undetermined
dns_correlation_incomplete.recommendation: Capture DNS alongside mail traffic so policy compliance can be assessed.

pqc_server_not_ready.title: Clients offer hybrid post-quantum key exchange; servers do not select it
pqc_server_not_ready.recommendation: Enable a hybrid PQC key exchange group (X25519MLKEM768) on the mail servers. Requires OpenSSL 3.5+ or equivalent. Prioritise by CNSA 2.0 timelines; until then, ensure forward secrecy everywhere so recorded traffic is not retrospectively readable.

certificate_expired.title: Certificate had already expired at capture time
certificate_expired.recommendation: Renew the certificate and automate renewal (ACME/certbot with a post-renewal reload). Expiry is the most common avoidable mail outage.

certificate_not_yet_valid.title: Certificate not yet valid at capture time
certificate_not_yet_valid.recommendation: Check server clock synchronisation (NTP) and the certificate's notBefore. Clients will reject this certificate until the validity window opens.

certificate_expiring_soon.title: Certificate close to expiry
certificate_expiring_soon.recommendation: Renew now and put expiry monitoring in place. Automate renewal so this never becomes an outage.

certificate_hostname_mismatch.title: Certificate does not cover the requested hostname
certificate_hostname_mismatch.recommendation: Reissue with the correct SAN entries. Strict clients will refuse the connection; lenient ones connect anyway, which is what makes this exploitable.

certificate_weak_key.title: Certificate public key below minimum strength
certificate_weak_key.recommendation: Reissue with RSA 2048-bit minimum (3072 preferred) or ECDSA P-256. Keys below this are factorable with attainable resources.

certificate_weak_signature.title: Certificate signed with a broken hash algorithm
certificate_weak_signature.recommendation: Reissue with SHA-256 or stronger. SHA-1 certificate collisions are demonstrated, so the signature no longer binds the identity.

certificate_self_signed.title: Self-signed certificate presented
certificate_self_signed.recommendation: Issue from an internal CA whose root is distributed to clients, or from a public CA. Self-signed certificates train users and administrators to ignore warnings.

certificate_chain_incomplete.title: Incomplete certificate chain presented
certificate_chain_incomplete.recommendation: Configure the server to send the full chain including intermediates. Postfix: smtpd_tls_chain_files. Clients lacking the intermediate will fail validation.

posture_weights._comment: Dimension weights for the SecureMailScope Posture Score. Editable: the score is our stated methodology, not a fixed rating.
